race.description: Apg Vicbred Super Series 4yo Mares Final (G1)
race.comment: Tricky draws for the three class mares mean this could be a tactical affair. I AM WILMA (11) has had an ideal preparation for this, leading for dominant wins in her two starts at this circuit and distance since a spell. A back row draw means she may need different tactics this time but she was an easy winner of the 3F final of this series last year and has yet to miss a place when third-up so should be peaking. GATESYS GEM (7) took advantage of a low draw to lead and dominate her heat last week. She draws wider but should still be able to roll forward from out there and owns strong records both here and the distance. JILLIBY DREAMLOVER (12) has ground to make up on GATESYS GEM through last week's second and cops another back row draw but last start was her first outing for nearly eight weeks and it should have brought her on. Showed her class with a Great Square win in July so could be the big improver. Looks a gap to the rest, SKYBELLA (1) may be next best from the ace draw.
